items.title: Meadowlark Winter Walk of Lights near DC: kids 2 to 12 free on six nights
items.when: November 11, 2026 to January 3, 2027 at Meadowlark Botanical Gardens, Vienna, Virginia. Open 5:30 to 10 p.m. through December 3, then 5 to 10 p.m.; last entry 9:30 p.m. Kids Nights: November 11, 16, 23 and 30, December 14 and January 2. The promotions page gives no year; we read these as this season. Only January 2 falls on a weekend.
items.cost: Per ticket, before tax and fees: $19 online or $24 at the door (November 11 to December 3 and January 1 to 3); $23, online only, December 4 to 31. No separate child price is listed. On Kids Nights, one free ticket for a child 2 to 12 with each paying guest. Parking is free. Two adults and two kids 2 to 12 on a Kids Night: $38, or $46 on December 14, against $76 or $92 if all four paid the listed price (estimate, before tax and fees).
items.booking: Online tickets are for a set entry time, and entry closes 30 minutes after it. For Kids Nights, add the "Kids Night BOGO Ticket, ages 2-12" when you buy online; it can't be combined with other discounts, and tickets already bought are not refunded. Tickets are non-refundable; you can rebook online before 2 p.m. on your date. It runs rain, snow or shine.
items.family: NOVA Parks recommends strollers: the one-way trail is paved and ADA accessible, about half a mile (NOVA Parks also says 0.6 mile), and it suggests 30 to 90 minutes. Hot drinks, pretzels and make-your-own s'mores are on site; no outside food. Parking is limited, so NOVA Parks suggests carpooling. The pages do not say whether children under 2 need a ticket.
items.source_label: NOVA Parks Winter Walk of Lights pages (tickets, promotions, rules)

post.when: Nov 11, 16, 23, 30, Dec 14 and Jan 2, in Vienna, VA. Only Jan 2 is a weekend.
post.cost: $38 for 2 adults + 2 kids, not $76: save about $38 (est.). Dec 14: $46, not $92. Before tax and fees.
post.catch: One free kid per paying guest, added online. No refunds.
post.top_cost: Kids Nights: $38 for 2 adults + 2 kids 2 to 12, $46 on Dec 14 (est., before tax and fees).

items.title: Chicago's Magnificent Mile Lights Festival: free parade and fireworks
items.when: Saturday, November 21, 2026. Booths with free Santa photos 11 a.m. to 4 p.m. at 401 N. Michigan Avenue; parade 5:30 p.m. from Oak Street, heading south along Michigan Avenue; fireworks near the DuSable Bridge at about 7:15 to 7:30 p.m. (official pages differ).
items.cost: Free: Choose Chicago, the city tourism board, lists the festival cost as free. Santa photos at the booths are free. Getting there can cost: the organizer lists a Metra (commuter rail) Saturday Day Pass at $7 per adult, with up to three children 11 and under free per paying adult, and paid garage parking.
items.booking: No tickets are listed for watching from the street; ticketed seating is not mentioned. Streets start closing as early as 8 a.m.; Michigan Avenue closes from Oak to Wacker from 3 p.m. to 7:30 p.m. The DuSable Bridge closes to walkers as early as 3 p.m.; the Columbus Drive Bridge is the organizer's alternative.
items.family: The organizer says the east side of Michigan Avenue is less crowded, especially at the north end, and that Wacker Drive is a good fireworks spot. Our planning note: fireworks run late for small kids, so Santa by day or the parade alone may suit them better. Stroller rules are not stated. It also streams live on abc7chicago.com.

post.when: Sat Nov 21, Michigan Avenue: parade 5:30 p.m., fireworks after 7 p.m.
post.cost: Free. Metra optional: $7 an adult, kids 11 and under free (family of 4 $14 est.).
post.catch: Free Santa photos 11 a.m. to 4 p.m. DuSable Bridge can close to walkers from 3 p.m.

items.title: Dyker Heights Christmas lights, Brooklyn: free to walk
items.when: Expected from about Friday, November 27, 2026. Sources put the end between Christmas and early January. Best after dark, from about 5 p.m.; some homes switch off as early as 9 p.m.
items.cost: Free to walk. Optional tours for a family of 4, estimate: walking about $140 ($35 each), bus from Midtown about $300 ($75 a seat). We saw no lower child price; check when booking.
items.booking: No ticket to walk it. Tours book on the company's page; its first 2026 tour is November 27.
items.family: Weeknights are quieter; mid-December weekends from 5 to 9 p.m. are busiest. Around 83rd to 86th Streets, 11th to 13th Avenues; R to 86 St or D to 79 St, then a 10 to 20 minute walk. It's a street of private homes, so stay on the sidewalk. We found nothing on strollers or restrooms.
items.third_party_note: We found no organizer or official 2026 dates. The start comes from a tour company and a Secret NYC headline; the guides describe last season.

post.when: From about Nov 27. Best after dark, about 5 p.m.
post.cost: Free to walk.
post.catch: Weeknights are quieter. We found nothing on strollers or restrooms.

items.title: Central Park fall colors: reported at peak, free to walk
items.when: Reported at peak on Wednesday, November 4, 2026. Colors change daily, so check the live map first. The park is open daily, 6 a.m. to 1 a.m.
items.cost: Free to walk: the Conservancy's visitor pages list no entry fee. Restrooms are free too, except at the zoo. Zoo tickets and other extras are not included.
items.booking: No booking to walk the park.
items.family: Reported spots: the Mall at 71st Street (American elms), the Ramble at 73rd to 79th, the Reservoir at 86th to 96th, the Great Hill at 103rd to 107th. East 72nd Street Playground is near the Mall. We found nothing on stroller routes; see the access map. Also on Saturday, Nov 7: free Meet the Tree Day at Rockefeller Center.

more_sources.label: Conservancy: what to know before you go

items.third_party_note: Secret NYC reads all eight park zones as Peak on the Conservancy's live map on November 4. We could not read the map's data ourselves.

post.when: Reported at peak Nov 4. Open daily, 6 a.m. to 1 a.m.
post.cost: Free to walk.
post.catch: Colors change daily: check the Conservancy's live map. One place to start: the Mall at 71st Street.

items.title: Holiday Train Show at Grand Central: free model trains, no strollers
items.when: Opens Friday, November 13, at the New York Transit Museum's Grand Central Gallery, in the Shuttle Passage off the Main Concourse. Gallery hours: weekdays 10 a.m. to 7:30 p.m., weekends 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. Closed Thanksgiving, Christmas and other listed holidays. The museum's pages give no closing date.
items.cost: Free. The museum lists admission as free; its visitor guide says no tickets are needed.
items.booking: No booking listed. The museum's visitor guide says it can be crowded and loud, and people take turns at the display.
items.family: Strollers are not allowed in the gallery, and unattended strollers are not allowed anywhere in the terminal, so the museum suggests leaving yours at home. Per its visitor guide (no year shown), model trains are in a large case, kids can't touch, and you can ask for a scavenger hunt sheet. The museum says the Main Concourse is wheelchair accessible from Lexington Avenue and 42nd Street, not Vanderbilt; it doesn't describe the route to the gallery.
items.source_label: New York Transit Museum exhibits page

more_sources.label: Transit Museum: know before you visit
Transit Museum: train show visitor guide (no year shown)

post.when: Opens Fri, Nov 13, Grand Central, NYC. Weekdays 10 to 7:30, weekends 10 to 6. No end date posted.
post.cost: Free, no tickets needed, per the museum.
post.catch: No strollers in the gallery. Closed Thanksgiving and Christmas Day.

items.title: Chicago Toy & Game Fair: character photos, costumed kids 7 and under free
items.when: Saturday Nov 7, 10 a.m. to 6 p.m., and Sunday Nov 8, 10 a.m. to 5 p.m., at the Donald E. Stephens Convention Center, 5555 N River Rd., Rosemont, Illinois.
items.cost: Kids 7 and under dressed as a Disney, Marvel, Star Wars or Pixar character get in free with a "Kids in Costume" ticket, added at checkout. Other ticket prices aren't shown on the pages we read, so no family-of-4 total; check the ticket page. Each ticket is good for one day only, and sales are final (no refunds or exchanges).
items.booking: Tickets are sold online through Eventbrite; door sales aren't mentioned. Grandparents, educators, librarians, scouts, first responders and military (active or veteran) can request free entry through a separate form (the Eventbrite page calls it complimentary access). Paid parking; the fair's page says it is across the street, without a rate.
items.family: The fair lists photos with Calico Critters and Star Wars characters, giant Jenga and Connect4, face painting and open tabletop games. It lists a separate form for families with special needs for its Super Power Sensory Hour; the time isn't on the pages we read. Strollers aren't mentioned, and no general age range is given. Grandparents Day is Sunday, with its own ticket form.

post.when: Last day Sun Nov 8, 10 a.m. to 5 p.m., Stephens Convention Center, Rosemont.
post.cost: Kids 7 and under in costume free: add the free ticket at checkout.
post.catch: Disney, Marvel, Star Wars or Pixar costumes only. One-day tickets, no refunds. Paid parking.

cost_link.label: Check other prices on the ticket page

items.title: JetBlue holiday checked bags: $49 and $69 on peak dates
items.when: Peak bag prices apply November 19 to 30, December 17 to 31 and January 1 to 18. November 5 to 18 and December 1 to 16 are off-peak.
items.cost: Per bag, Main and EvenMore fares, U.S., Caribbean, Latin America and Canada routes. Peak dates: $49 first bag, $69 second, when added at least 24 hours before departure. JetBlue says those prices include $10 savings, so at least $59 and $79 later, by our arithmetic; this page lists no airport price. Off-peak: $45 and $59, including $4 and $10 savings. Family of 4 estimate on peak dates, 2 checked bags there and back: $196, or at least $236 if added later. It assumes 2 travelers check one bag each and pay each way; JetBlue's pages list prices per bag and do not state per traveler or each way. One person checking both bags pays the $69 second-bag price: $236 there and back at the lower price.
items.booking: Add bags before check-in, at least 24 hours before departure, for the lower price. JetBlue lists the first bag as included for JetBlue Plus and Premier cardmembers, with conditions in its footnotes. A third or later bag is $200.
items.family: JetBlue's contract says one infant stroller and one infant car seat can be checked at no charge, on top of your bags. JetBlue says strollers are not covered for damage if checked. Lap infants get no checked bag allowance, and playpens count as a bag. These prices apply across the routes listed, not only from New York; other airlines differ.

post.when: Peak prices Nov 19 to 30, Dec 17 to 31, Jan 1 to 18. U.S., Caribbean, Latin America, Canada routes.
post.cost: Main and EvenMore: $49 first bag, $69 second, 24+ hours ahead; at least $10 more a bag later.
post.catch: Family of 4, 2 people check 1 bag each, there and back: $196, at least $236 if added late (est.)
post.chip: One infant stroller and one infant car seat check free

items.title: Bryant Park Cozy Igloos are back: 90-minute heated sessions
items.when: Open since Thursday, November 5, 2026, by the skating pavilion in the southeast corner of the Rink deck, Bryant Park, Midtown Manhattan. Each session is 90 minutes. Bryant Park's page lists no closing date and no hours.
items.cost: Packages start at $259.61, taxes and fees included (the same page's FAQ says $253.96); the page doesn't say which party size or date that price is for. There are packages for 1-4 and for 5-8 guests, so a family of 4 books the 1-4 package; prices vary by party size and on holiday dates. Each package includes shared drinks and one set food item per guest. Gratuity isn't mentioned. Skating is not included.
items.booking: Book a package online through the page's Peek link; you can't sit in an igloo without one. No refunds; you can reschedule up to 48 hours before by email or phone. Bring the card you paid with and the buyer's ID.
items.family: All ages welcome; kids under 2 don't need a food item but count toward the 8-person limit. Heated and open rain, snow or shine, but Bryant Park may cancel for severe weather (the page doesn't say what happens to your booking then); an extra layer helps below freezing. You can't move between the rink and the igloo during a session. Strollers aren't covered on the page. No outside food.

post.when: Open now at Bryant Park, Midtown. 90 minutes; all ages.
post.cost: From $259.61 a package, taxes and fees in; page doesn't say for how many (1-4 or 5-8 guest packages).
post.catch: No refunds; skating not included; holiday prices may differ.

items.title: DiwaliSA Festival of Lights: dance, Indian food and fireworks in downtown San Antonio
items.when: Saturday, November 7, 2026, 4:30 p.m. to midnight, at Hemisfair and the Arneson River Theater, downtown. Fireworks are listed, but neither page gives a time.
items.cost: No ticket or price on the 2026 organizer or Hemisfair pages. Visit San Antonio said admission was free last year; check the organizer page before you go. Food vendors; no prices listed.
items.booking: No tickets or sign-up listed. Hosted by Anuja SA; the festival marks San Antonio's sister-city tie with Chennai, India.
items.family: Hemisfair's page promises music, dance, food and "family fun"; no kids' activities are named. Neither page covers parking, strollers or a rain plan. Fireworks can be loud for small kids; ear protection helps.

more_sources.label: Visit San Antonio DiwaliSA post (free admission, last year)

post.when: Saturday, Nov 7, 4:30 p.m. to midnight, Hemisfair, downtown San Antonio.
post.cost: No price posted for this year; free last year. Check the organizer page first.
post.catch: Fireworks listed, no time posted. No kids' activities, parking or stroller notes posted.

items.title: Wurstfest in New Braunfels: German food, polka and carnival rides, kids 12 and under free
items.when: Friday, November 6 to Sunday, November 15, 2026, at Landa Park in New Braunfels, northeast of San Antonio. Saturdays 11 a.m. to midnight, Sundays 11 a.m. to 10 p.m., weekdays 5 p.m. to 10 or 11 p.m. (opening Friday from 4 p.m.).
items.cost: Kids 12 and under free every day. Adults, online: $15 Fridays and Sundays, $25 Saturdays; at the gate $20 and $30. Monday to Thursday free for everyone, and the last Sunday is free after 3 p.m. Estimate for 2 adults and 2 kids 12 or under: $0 Monday to Thursday, $30 on a Friday or Sunday, $50 on a Saturday, online. Park 'N Ride: free parking, shuttle $10 per person 13 and up, so $20 for 2 adults (per-ride or round trip not stated); no fees listed; ride and carnival prices not listed.
items.booking: Buy online ahead: it is $5 cheaper per adult than the gate. For ID checks, only physical state-issued IDs are accepted (no digital IDs). Parking next to the grounds is limited; the Park 'N Ride runs from Comal County Fairgrounds, 701 Common Street.
items.family: The festival lists carnival rides and children's groups (Edelweiss Kinder Chor, Kinder Tanzer) among its shows; no kids' area is named. It runs rain or shine, bags are searched, no pets except service animals, no bag chairs. No stroller notes posted. Beer is sold on the grounds.

more_sources.label: KSAT: what to know before you visit (news lead)

post.when: Nov 6-15, Landa Park, New Braunfels. Weekends from 11 a.m.; Mon-Fri evenings from 5 p.m.
post.cost: Kids 12 and under free. Adults $15-$25 online; free Monday to Thursday.
post.catch: ID checks: physical state ID only. Parking is limited; shuttle $10 per person 13+, kids free.

items.title: Chicago: Santa breakfasts and meals under Macy's Great Tree
items.when: The Great Tree is up from Saturday, November 7, 2026 to Sunday, January 17, 2027, in the Marshall Field's Walnut Room, 7th floor of Macy's, 111 N. State Street in the Loop. Seating hours: Nov 7, 11 a.m. to 7 p.m.; Nov 8-21, Monday to Saturday 10 a.m. to 7 p.m., Sunday 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. (first to last seating); later hours on the Walnut Room page. Closed Thanksgiving; Christmas Eve until 3 p.m.; closed Christmas Day.
items.cost: The menus are posted only as images, which we couldn't read, so we have no prices and no family-of-4 estimate; check the menu before you book. There is a kids' menu (a holiday placemat menu). Breakfast with Santa and a Great Tree Breakfast Buffet (eleven dates) are listed; their dates and prices aren't in the page text.
items.booking: Holiday reservations are online through OpenTable, linked from the Walnut Room page, which says to book the breakfasts early. Large groups book through Macy's events page. The page doesn't mention deposits, cancellations or walk-ins.
items.family: Breakfast with Santa is a family brunch with Santa and Mrs. Claus and kids' activities. The page doesn't say whether you can see the tree without a table, and has no stroller notes.

post.when: Tree Nov 7-Jan 17; Santa breakfasts on select dates. Walnut Room restaurant, Macy's 7th floor.
post.cost: Prices not posted; check the menu before you book. Kids' menu offered.
post.catch: Reserve on OpenTable; book Santa breakfasts early. Unclear if you can see the tree without a table.

items.title: Diwali at the Children's Museum of Manhattan: sky lamps, rangoli, dance and a puppet show
items.when: Sunday, November 8, 2026, 10:30 a.m. to 4 p.m. with a crafts-only day (sky lamps and rangoli) Tuesday, November 10. At 212 West 83rd Street, Upper West Side. The museum is open Tuesday to Sunday, 10 a.m. to 5 p.m.
items.cost: Museum admission online: $17 for adults and for children 1-18, free under 12 months; $1 more at the door. Estimate for 2 adults and 2 kids 1 or older: $68 online, $72 at the door. The Diwali events page doesn't say whether the programs are included with admission or cost extra.
items.booking: Walk-up tickets are sold; booking online saves $1 a person and, the museum says, ensures your spot. The events page doesn't mention sign-up for the Diwali programs.
items.family: Sunday: paper sky lamps (10:30 a.m.-12:30 p.m.), tissue-paper rangoli collage (11:15 a.m. and 2:45 p.m.), a Diwali dance workshop (2 p.m.), a Ramleela puppet show (2:45 p.m.) and a bilingual storytime with a marigold craft (3:30 p.m.). Tuesday: sky lamps and rangoli only. The museum's hands-on programs are designed for ages 0-6; no ages are given per event. Strollers aren't allowed in exhibit areas; free stroller and coat check.
items.source_label: Children's Museum of Manhattan Diwali events

post.when: Sun Nov 8, 10:30 a.m.-4 p.m.; crafts again Tue Nov 10. Upper West Side.
post.cost: Museum entry about $68 for 2 adults + 2 kids (1+) online (estimate); under 1 free.
post.catch: Made for ages 0-6. Not said if Diwali programs cost extra; no strollers in exhibits.

items.title: Free Diwali afternoon at Brooklyn Children's Museum: diya lamps, sweets and puppet stories
items.when: Thursday, November 12, 2026, 2 to 5 p.m., at 145 Brooklyn Avenue, Crown Heights, Brooklyn. Last entry 4:50 p.m.
items.cost: Free: Thursdays 2-5 p.m. are free Community Access hours, so $0 for a family of 4. Other days admission is $15 a person (the page lists no age prices).
items.booking: Free tickets can be reserved online ahead or picked up at the museum that day; the page doesn't say a reservation is required. The event page has an RSVP link. Group visits are restricted in the free hours.
items.family: Puppet storytelling about Diwali, making mithai (Indian sweets) and diya lamps in the ColorLab art studio, with The Culture Tree. No ages are given; strollers aren't covered on the visit page.
items.source_label: Brooklyn Children's Museum Celebrate Diwali page

more_sources.label: Brooklyn Children's Museum visit page (hours, free Thursdays)

post.when: Thu Nov 12, 2-5 p.m., Crown Heights, Brooklyn.
post.cost: Free (Thursday 2-5 p.m. free hours); $0 for a family of 4.
post.catch: Reserve free tickets online or get them at the door; last entry 4:50 p.m. No ages given.

items.title: Walt Disney World water parks: seasonal pass $89; Typhoon Lagoon back Jan 27, 2027
items.when: Disney says Typhoon Lagoon is closed for refurbishment and will reopen January 27, 2027; Blizzard Beach is open meanwhile. The Disney Water Park Seasonal Pass is valid through May 15, 2027, with blockout dates. Disney lists no last day to buy it.
items.cost: Disney Water Park Seasonal Pass: $89 for ages 10 and up, $83 for ages 3 to 9, plus tax. 1-Day Water Park Ticket: $79 and $69. 1-Day Water Park Ticket with Blockout Dates (the cheaper, date-restricted ticket): $69 and $59. Disney shows the ticket total at checkout. Under 3 free. Family of 4 estimate (2 adults, kids aged 6 and 9), before tax: four seasonal passes $344; one visit on the blockout-date ticket $256, two visits $512, so passes save $168 (33%) on two visits. For one visit, day tickets cost less.
items.booking: Buy on Disney's water park tickets page; Disney calls the pass a limited-time offer. A ticket or pass covers Blizzard Beach or Typhoon Lagoon, whichever is open, so check Disney's park calendar and the pass blockout dates before you go.
items.family: Disney-specific: these prices are for Walt Disney World's two water parks only. Guests at Disney Resorts Collection hotels normally get one free water park day on check-in day, but Disney says that benefit has ended for 2026 and returns in summer 2027, dates not announced. Children under 3 need no ticket.
items.source_label: Walt Disney World water park tickets

post.when: Blizzard Beach open now; Typhoon Lagoon reopens Jan 27, 2027.
post.cost: Seasonal pass to May 15, 2027 (blockout dates): $89 ages 10+, $83 ages 3-9, plus tax.
post.catch: Family of 4, 2 visits: day tickets $512, passes $344, save $168 (est.); 1 visit: tickets cheaper.

items.title: Air and Space Museum in DC: hands-on space gallery now open, new jets gallery from Nov 11
items.when: Modern Military Aviation opens Wednesday, November 11, 2026 (Veterans Day); At Home in Space opened October 30. Both are in the National Air and Space Museum on the National Mall, open daily 10 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., closed December 25. The museum says they complete its seven-year rebuild.
items.cost: Free. Everyone needs a free timed-entry pass, whatever their age, so a family of 4 books 4 passes; one booking holds up to nine. The Mars Café, IMAX and a planetarium are also on site (prices not read; check the museum site). The museum has no parking; nearby metered spots and paid lots only.
items.booking: Reserve free timed-entry passes on the museum site before you go; a pass does not limit how long you stay. The pages we read do not say how far ahead passes open or whether walk-up passes are offered. Enter on Jefferson Drive SW.
items.family: At Home in Space is the more hands-on gallery for kids: the museum calls it "highly interactive", with a Spaceflight Academy Quiz game, a mock-up of the space station's Destiny module, a flown spacesuit, Robonaut 1A and Sally Ride's flight suit. Modern Military Aviation shows an F-86 Sabre jet, a Huey helicopter and a Predator drone, and covers wars and nuclear weapons; no age guidance or kids' features are listed. Metro: L'Enfant Plaza, Exit A, about a 10-minute walk. The pages we read cover no stroller rules.
items.source_label: National Air and Space Museum release (Oct 22) and visit pages

more_sources.label: Visit the museum in DC (free timed-entry passes)

post.when: Space gallery open now; jets gallery from Wed Nov 11. Daily 10 a.m.-5:30 p.m., National Mall.
post.cost: Free, but all 4 of you need free timed-entry passes, kids included.
post.catch: Jets gallery covers wars; no age guidance. No parking: Metro to L'Enfant Plaza, Exit A.

items.title: Chicago: Dan Ryan exit to Roosevelt Road, near the Museum Campus, closed to about Nov 23
items.when: Closed from November 9, 2026 (a Monday; weather permitting) for about two weeks; the state transportation department (IDOT) expects the work to be done by Monday, November 23. The ramp is the inbound Dan Ryan Expressway (I-90/94) exit to Roosevelt Road and Taylor Street; Peoples Gas is doing the work.
items.cost: Road closure only; we did not check museum prices or hours. The Field Museum lists Soldier Field North Garage parking at $27 for up to 4 hours or $32 for up to 12 hours, and the East Museum Lot at $32 for up to 12 hours (no dates given; rates can change on Bears and Fire game days, and Shedd says the North Garage can switch to a $30 special-event rate without notice). Check CTA fares on the CTA site.
items.booking: Nothing to book. IDOT's detour: take the outbound Eisenhower Expressway (I-290) exit, go west to Ashland Avenue, then to Roosevelt Road and Taylor Street. IDOT says to expect delays and allow extra time. Shedd Aquarium asks visitors to check its traffic alerts page before each visit.
items.family: Roosevelt Road runs east to the Museum Campus (Field Museum, Shedd Aquarium, Adler Planetarium); IDOT's release does not mention the museums, and the local news site Secret Chicago first reported that angle. To skip the drive: the CTA Red, Orange and Green lines stop at Roosevelt, which the Field Museum calls its closest train stop; the #146 bus and the Metra Electric Museum Campus/11th Street station also serve the campus.

post.when: Closed Nov 9 (weather permitting) to about Mon Nov 23, per IDOT.
post.cost: Road closure only. Soldier Field garage (Field Museum list): $27 up to 4 hours.
post.catch: Detour via I-290 and Ashland, or take the CTA to Roosevelt.

items.title: New in Harlem: Urban Civil Rights Museum opens Saturday, Nov 14
items.when: Grand opening weekend Saturday, November 14 and Sunday, November 15, 2026. After that the museum lists hours of Wednesday to Saturday 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. and Sunday noon to 5 p.m.; Monday and Tuesday are not listed. Its special exhibition, Thriving! Harlem as Homeplace, runs to May 17, 2027.
items.cost: Ticket prices are not posted on the museum pages we read (November 9); check the museum site before you go. The tours page lists daily free public tours, with no times posted and no word on whether museum admission is extra.
items.booking: The museum asks self-guided visitors to reserve ahead on its booking page; self-guided entry runs 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. Wednesday to Saturday and noon to 4 p.m. Sunday. Guided tours start at 10 a.m., 1 p.m. and 3 p.m. Wednesday to Saturday and at 1 p.m. and 3 p.m. Sunday; groups book at least 4 weeks ahead. The pages we read do not say whether opening weekend needs a ticket.
items.family: The museum covers the long fight for civil rights in Northern cities; its permanent exhibition is Moving History Forward. The tours page says its offerings suit visitors "of all ages" and it runs K-12 school visits, but it gives no age guidance for young children. It is on the 4th floor of 117 W 125th Street in Harlem, in the Urban League Empowerment Center. The pages we read give no subway, stroller or accessibility details.

post.when: Opens Sat Nov 14 at 117 W 125th St (4th floor), Harlem. Then Wed-Sat 10 a.m.-5 p.m., Sun noon-5 p.m.
post.cost: Prices not posted yet (as of Nov 9); check the museum site.
post.catch: Opening-weekend ticket rules not posted; reserve visits ahead. No age guidance for little kids.

items.title: SeaWorld Orlando Veterans Weekend fireworks, Nov 13-15
items.when: Friday, November 13 to Sunday, November 15, 2026, at SeaWorld Orlando. Veterans Fireworks with live music run each night after sunset over Bayside Stadium; SeaWorld does not post a start time.
items.cost: SeaWorld lists the fireworks, show salutes, Field of Honor flags and Sammie the Sea Otter meet-and-greets as included with park admission, so any ticket holder can see them. Veterans and up to five guests get 50% off a single-day ticket (used by December 31, 2026). SeaWorld's Tickets page (read November 13) lists single-day tickets from $59.99 a person (ages 3+; price varies by date; parking, taxes and fees extra), so 2 adults and 2 kids aged 3+ start at about $240 before the veterans discount.
items.booking: The veterans discount is bought online only, with ID.me identity verification; SeaWorld says it runs while supplies last and taxes are extra. A Military and Pass Member Picnic runs Sunday, November 15, noon to 4 p.m. at Ports of Call, for military and Pass Members; the page does not say whether guests can come.
items.family: For little kids: Sammie the Sea Otter meet-and-greets (times on the park's daily schedule) and salutes at the orca, dolphin and sea lion shows. Fireworks start after sunset (no time posted), so plan to stay into the evening. Parking is not covered here.

post.when: Fri Nov 13 to Sun Nov 15 at SeaWorld Orlando; fireworks each night after sunset.
post.cost: Included with any park ticket. Veterans + up to 5 guests: 50% off a day ticket (ID.me).
post.catch: No fireworks time posted; day tickets from $59.99 a person, varying by date.

items.title: Ethel M Holiday Cactus Garden Lights: $12 for a family of 4 (kids 2+), Santa daily to Dec 23
items.when: Nightly November 5, 2026 to January 3, 2027 at Ethel M Chocolates, 2 Cactus Garden Drive, Henderson (Las Vegas area). Most nights 5 to 10 p.m.; Dec 24, Dec 31 and Jan 1 close at 8 p.m.; closed Christmas Day.
items.cost: $3 a person, cash or card (proceeds go to Help of Southern Nevada and Three Square Food Bank); children under 2 and adults 65 and up free, so 2 adults + 2 kids aged 2 and up pay $12. Santa photos are extra: $35 for one 8x6 print, $50 for two.
items.booking: No reservations needed for the garden. Optional Santa Express Pass, $40 for up to 6 people, gives front-of-line Santa access at a booked time (Nov 6 to Dec 23).
items.family: Santa is there daily from 5 p.m. through Dec 23 (line closes at 9 p.m.), so go early with little kids. Park in an Ethel M lot or the Smith's lot across the street; Ethel M says cars in nearby business-park lots are towed. No pets (cactus); we saw no stroller notes.
items.source_label: Ethel M Holiday Cactus Garden page

post.when: Nightly to Jan 3 (closed Dec 25) in Henderson, Las Vegas area, mostly 5-10 p.m.; Santa daily to Dec 23.
post.cost: $3 a person, under 2 free: $12 for a family of 4. Santa photos from $35.
post.catch: Santa line closes 9 p.m.; park only in Ethel M or Smith's lots (others tow).

items.title: Las Vegas Magical Forest: holiday lights, train, carousel and Santa from Nov 27
items.when: Nov 27-29, Dec 3-24 and Dec 26 to Jan 1 (closed Nov 30-Dec 2 and Christmas Day) at 6300 W. Oakey Blvd., Las Vegas. Sunday to Thursday 5:30 to 9 p.m., Friday and Saturday 5:30 to 9:30 p.m.; the box office closes 30 minutes before the park.
items.cost: Single-ticket price not posted on the official pages we read; groups of 10 or more pay $19 each on non-peak nights and $21 on peak nights (peak nights not listed), so check the ticket site linked there. Kids 3 and under are free. Midway games are $5 each; food is extra.
items.booking: New this year: tickets are for one date. They are non-refundable. Opportunity Village recommends buying online; the box office also sells tickets. Senior and military discounts are at the box office only.
items.family: Opportunity Village's holiday park, with the Forest Express train, a carousel, a 50-foot slide, 8-hole mini golf and Santa visits. Rides need riders 42 inches tall unless a guardian rides along. Free parking in the College of Southern Nevada lot. Diaper bags are fine; backpacks are not; we saw no stroller notes.

post.when: Set nights Nov 27 to Jan 1, from 5:30 p.m., west Las Vegas.
post.cost: Single-ticket price not posted; groups of 10+ pay $19-$21 each. Kids 3 and under free.
post.catch: One-date, non-refundable tickets; closed Nov 30-Dec 2 and Dec 25.

items.title: Obama Presidential Center museum: new tickets on sale Wed Nov 11; $106 for a family of 4
items.when: The museum adds ticket availability on the second Wednesday of each month at 10 a.m. CT, which this month is Wednesday, November 11, 2026. Tickets cover visit dates about six months out. Museum hours: Monday 1 to 8 p.m., Tuesday to Sunday 10 a.m. to 5 p.m.; closed Thanksgiving and Christmas Day.
items.cost: $30 a person 12 and up, $23 ages 3 to 11, free 2 and under (some official pages say 3 and under). 2 adults + 2 kids aged 3 to 11 pay $106; Illinois residents pay $82 (adults $26, kids $15) and can get free Tuesday tickets online, if slots remain, with proof of residency. Garage parking is $22 for up to 4 hours.
items.booking: Timed-entry tickets, online only; staff do not sell at the door. Up to 9 tickets an order, with 10 minutes to check out. Babies and children need a ticket too, including free ones, reserved at checkout. Tickets are non-refundable; you can ask to reschedule up to 72 hours ahead. For a free Tuesday, choose a Tuesday slot, pick Illinois Resident General Admission and enter an Illinois zip code; bring a photo ID showing residency.
items.family: Plan at least two hours; last entry is 3:15 p.m. (6:15 p.m. Mondays) and arrive 10 minutes early, as later arrivals may not be admitted. Strollers are welcome (use the elevators), but wagons and double-wide strollers are not allowed. Family restrooms are on the Museum's lower levels and at Home Court. The free campus outside has a playground. Some exhibits may close January 4 to February 26, 2027.
items.source_label: Obama Presidential Center Museum Tickets page

post.when: New museum tickets go on sale Wed Nov 11 at 10 a.m. CT, for visits about six months out.
post.cost: $106 for 2 adults + 2 kids 3-11 (2 and under free). Illinois residents $82; free Tuesday slots online.
post.catch: Online only, non-refundable; no double-wide strollers or wagons.

items.title: Festival of Trees at the Orlando Museum of Art, Nov 14-22
items.when: Daily Saturday, November 14 to Sunday, November 22, 2026, 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. (Tuesday, November 17 closes at 3 p.m.), at the Orlando Museum of Art in Loch Haven Park. It is the festival's 40th year.
items.cost: $23 adults, $15 ages 3 to 12 (family of 2 adults + kids 4 and 8: $76, est.). Parking is $8 a day in the lot next to the museum during the festival. The festival pages don't say what kids under 3 pay.
items.booking: Tickets sell on Eventbrite; the museum shows no timed entry. Breakfast with Santa (Nov 14, 15, 21, 8:30-10 a.m.) and the Reindeer Romp kids' party (Fri Nov 20, 6:30-9 p.m.) are separate events with no price listed.
items.family: Decorated trees and gingerbread on display, Santa on Santa Claus Lane on weekends (Nov 14-15 and 21-22) 10 a.m. to 5 p.m., and strollers are welcome in the galleries.
items.source_label: Orlando Museum of Art festival page
